reason: A DSH Web UI extension that adds a 7D7D game portal for hosting, synchronizing, generating, and playing local HTML5 and self-hosted Ruffle Flash games.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 添加 7D7D 游戏门户，用于托管、同步、生成并游玩本地 HTML5 与自托管 Ruffle Flash 小游戏。
summaries.en: Adds a 7D7D game portal to the DSH Web UI for hosting, synchronizing, generating, and playing local HTML5 and self-hosted Ruffle Flash games.

capabilities: Adds a 7D7D tab and game portal to the DSH Web UI
Hosts and serves local HTML5 and self-hosted Flash games
Executes games inside sandboxed browser iframes
Scans a configured game directory and synchronizes repository or optional remote catalog games
Provides a skill for generating HTML5 games and writes generated game files to the game library
